evaluation.feedback: I really enjoyed this track! The late-night R&B vibes are spot on. The percussion is crisp and well-mixed, and the subtle vocal chops that enter halfway through add a great layer of depth. It has a professional, polished sound that works perfectly as a 'vibe' track.
evaluation.suggested_prompt: A smooth, atmospheric late-night R&B track with a slow, groovy hip-hop beat, deep melodic synth bass, and ethereal, processed vocal textures. Maintain the C# minor key and mellow energy.
